patch_description: Add a seed-perturbation restart loop: refactor the greedy + local search into an inner routine, run it multiple times (e.g., 12 restarts), where each restart perturbs the greedy tie-breaking among near-equal best-fit GPUs (choosing randomly among GPUs whose resulting KVPR is within a small epsilon of the best), and keep the placement with the lowest final max KVPR. This diversifies beyond the deterministic greedy, which can get stuck in greedy lockstep, and was a pattern in perfect-scoring variants.
